oneOf.title: Attach to a running JVM (JDWP)
oneOf.description: Attach to a JVM launched with JDWP agent (e.g. `./gradlew run --debug-jvm` or `-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=5005`).

hostName.description: Host of the remote debuggee JVM.

port.description: JDWP port of the debuggee JVM (5005 for `gradle run --debug-jvm`).

oneOf.title: Launch a Kotlin/JVM application
oneOf.description: Launch a JVM program under the debugger. A full classpath is required today; auto-resolution from the workspace is planned.

mainClass.description: Fully qualified name of the class with the main entry point (file-level mains get a `Kt` suffix, e.g. `com.example.AppKt`).

classPaths.description: JVM classpath entries (compiled classes dirs and dependency jars).

javaExec.description: Path to the java executable. Defaults to the project's resolved JDK.

args.description: Command line arguments passed to the program.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the program.

cwd.description: Working directory of the program. Defaults to the project root.
